description: We're Nabateens, a team of four passionate physics and astrophysics students from Jordan combining ancient heritage with modern innovation. Driven by our love for physics and game design, we're building an interactive space mission game for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
summary: Project Title: From Earth to Mars  Human Colonization Game The game simulates a journey .from Earth to Mars Players launch a spacecraft .and travel through space The main goal is to explore the .planet Mars Players discover natural resources on the Martian .surface They build shelters for future .human settlers They develop systems to .produce oxygen and water They establish a sustainable .human colony The game teaches players about space exploration and .planetary science  ,It encourages creativity problem-solving, and scientific .thinking The main goal is to educate users about the dangers and challenges of traveling to Mars, including the risks of space travel, harsh environmental conditions, limited resources, and the difficulties of establishing human life on another planet.
